description:
About our brand and products:
Radiate is a small-batch, organic kombucha brand from Miami, brewed traditionally with local ingredients, live cultures, and organic cane sugar. Found in 30+ Florida Whole Foods locations and shipping nationwide, with rotating flavors made in-house.

What makes us different:
We're woman-owned and rooted in local sourcing raw, unpasteurized kombucha with creative, ever-changing flavors, backed by a genuine Miami community story that resonates with wellness-minded audiences.

How affiliates can earn:
Earn commission on every sale generated through your unique affiliate link or discount code. 

How to promote us:
Ideal for wellness, gut-health, or clean-living content — think reviews, "what's in my fridge" posts, or Whole Foods shopping guides, paired with a discount code for your audience.

Other information:
Product photos, ingredient details, and sample product available on request for affiliate content creation.

Welcome to the Radiate Kombucha Affiliate Partner Program! 

We're a woman + mom-owned, organic kombucha brand brewed in Miami, and we're glad you're considering joining us in cultivating culture, community, and compassion — one can at a time.

These Terms and Conditions (the “Terms”) govern your participation in the Radiate Kombucha Affiliate Partner Program (the “Program”) as either Radiate Kombucha (“we,” “our,” or “merchant”) or an affiliate partner (“you,” “affiliate,” or “partner”) who refers customers to purchase Radiate products.

By applying to or participating in the Program, you agree to be bound by these Terms in full. If you do not agree, you are not authorized to register as an affiliate or participate in the Program.


1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.


2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

Affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If customer both click on the affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliate may also advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram,... or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.

3. Disclosure Requirements

As a condition of participating in the Program, you agree to clearly and conspicuously disclose your affiliate relationship with Radiate Kombucha in every post, video, story, or other content that promotes your affiliate link or coupon code, in accordance with FTC guidelines on endorsements and testimonials. 

• Acceptable disclosures include hashtags or labels such as #ad, #sponsored, #RadiatePartner, or “Paid partnership with Radiate Kombucha,” placed where your audience will easily see them (not buried in additional hashtags). 

• Failure to disclose your affiliate relationship may result in suspension or removal from the Program.

4. Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost,...).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.

5. Content Usage Rights 

Any content you create that features, mentions, or promotes Radiate Kombucha products in connection with the Program (“Affiliate Content”) — including photos, videos, reviews, and social posts — may be requested for use in our marketing. 

• By submitting or tagging Radiate Kombucha in Affiliate Content, you grant us a non-exclusive, royalty-free, worldwide license to repost, reshare, and feature that content on our website, social channels, email marketing, and paid advertising, with credit to you where reasonably possible.

 • This license continues for content already shared during your participation in the Program, even if your participation later ends, unless you request removal in writing.

 • You retain ownership of your original content; we are only licensed to use it as described above.

6. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels.

7. Network

If Network tab is activated, affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate. If any downline affiliate brings order to merchant shop, upline affiliate will also get network commission which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share network link and any other affiliate who click on that link and sign up will become a downline affiliate.


8. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies day is said on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then)

9. Exclusivity and Competing Brands

You are not required to promote Radiate Kombucha exclusively. However, if you are simultaneously promoting a directly competing functional-beverage or kombucha brand, you agree to disclose this to us upon request.

  • We reserve the right to offer enhanced commission rates, early access, or other benefits to partners who promote Radiate Kombucha on an exclusive or first-priority basis, at our discretion.

10. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: susan@radiatemiami.com.

Welcome to the Family

Thank you for considering a partnership with Radiate Kombucha. We're a small, local, organic brand built on real ingredients and real community, and we're excited to grow alongside partners who feel the same way. If you have any questions about these Terms, reach out anytime at ecommerce@radiatemiami.com
